boundary: Product probability space Omega = (n : Nat) -> Bool with measure mu = Pi n bernoulli(p n) where p n = min(1, sqrt(log(n+1)/(n+1))) with c=1. Random set A(omega) := { n | omega n = true }. Witness is pair (A, pi).

opcodes.VINIT: seed Omega and its product measure mu as the genesis of the random set
opcodes.FSPLIT: decompose E[r A n] = sum_{a=1}^{n-1} p_a p_{n-a} over the two summand arms a and n-a
opcodes.AREV: reverse Var[r A n] <= E[r A n] + E[r A n]^2 to isolate the deviation from the mean
opcodes.EVALT: deposit the limit constant pi as the target kinetic value
opcodes.AFWD: Cauchy-Schwarz bound on second moment pairs summand terms as adjoint
opcodes.FFUSE: Chebyshev on subsequence n_k=2^k fuses deviation probability back with mean
opcodes.IMSCRIB: self-reference: A(omega) is defined by omega which indexes the summands of r

frobenius.split_input: mean functional E[r A n] / log n decomposed over summand pair (a, n-a) as p_a p_{n-a} / log n
frobenius.fuse_result: limit pi reconstructed from Var/log n -> 0 and almost-sure convergence of the subsequence

sequence: VINIT FSPLIT AREV EVALT AFWD FFUSE AFWD IMSCRIB IMSCRIB FFUSE
